title: assert-vm-route judges system units; bots are systemd USER units

defect.observed: Line 141 runs: systemctl list-units bot-host@* --no-legend --state=running | wc -l — with NO --user. The bots are systemd USER units under /home/ubuntu/.config/systemd/user, so system-level systemctl sees none of them. Measured on this box: system units 0, user units 2 (bot-host@vm2 and bot-host@vm3 running, bot-host@agenda dead). So a live VM with bots up reports units=0.
defect.expected: Count USER units, i.e. systemctl --user list-units bot-host@* --no-legend --state=running, or equivalent, so a running bot-host unit is actually seen.
defect.criteria: node scripts/assert-vm-route.mjs --live passes on a box where bot-host@vm2 and bot-host@vm3 are running. Red-proven: the current system-level form still reports units=0 on that same healthy box. The default offline run must continue to judge only the written record and never the network.
